title: When the phone is locked, AAPS disconnects and stops running
body: Huawei/Honor phone, patch pump + AAPS. Whenever the phone screen is locked for about an hour, AAPS disconnects, including the glucose data link. This happens because AAPS does not have a direct data source option for the Sibionics CGM. My setup: Sibionics official app + xdrip + AAPS + patch pump.

comments.body:
see Don't kill my app in About dialog
